priorityList: Summon your primary demon pet before combat begins.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities while your Demonic Tyrant is active.
Cast Power Siphon if you have 1 or 0 stacks of Demonic Core to generate procs.
Cast Grimoire: Imp Lord or Grimoire: Fel Ravager on cooldown.
Cast Summon Demonic Tyrant on cooldown, ideally after summoning your other major demons.
Cast Implosion if you have 6 or more Wild Imps active during AoE encounters.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan when you have 3 or more Soul Shards to spend resources and generate imps.
Cast Demonbolt if you have Demonic Core procs and fewer than 4 Soul Shards.
When casting Demonbolt, prioritize targets that do not currently have the Doom debuff.
Use Shadow Bolt as your primary filler to generate Soul Shards when no other actions are available.
